import os

base_dir = "~/documents/work/meetings_data/"
file_names = set()

for file_path in files:
    # Extract the filename from the path
    filename = os.path.basename(file_path)
    # Split into name and extension
    name, ext = os.path.splitext(filename)
    # Split the name by "__" to get date and file_name
    parts = name.split("__", 1)
    if len(parts) == 2:
        date, file_name = parts
        file_names.add(file_name)

print("Unique file names:", file_names)

steps.code:
# Now let me move each file to the new structure: <file_name>/<date>.<extension>
for file_path in files:
    filename = os.path.basename(file_path)
    name, ext = os.path.splitext(filename)
    parts = name.split("__", 1)
    if len(parts) == 2:

        new_file_path = f"{base_dir}{file_name}/{date}{ext}"
        response = apis.file_system.move_file(access_token=access_token, source_file_path=file_path, destination_file_path=new_file_path, overwrite=False, retain_dates=True)
